title: One thing I’ve started appreciating about trading
author: collosal01
selftext:
I’ve slowly realised one of the biggest advantages of swing trading isn’t just having to watch the charts less.  
It’s having more time to think before making the next decision.  
When I was trying to be involved in every little move, it felt like I was constantly reacting.  
Now, even if I don’t catch every opportunity, I feel like the decisions I do make are far more deliberate.  
Funny how slowing everything down can actually make you feel more in control.
